annotations.text:
The counter as it stands, rebuilt from the app's own stylesheet.

Square corners everywhere now, tabs carry the customer's name rather than the amount, the Cancel button is gone, and the payment dialog can spend loyalty points — all of that is live in the app, not just drawn here.

Theme and Density above each artboard are the app's own two levers.

Items & Pricing, which you said looked too simple — this is where it is headed.

Price lists with quantity tiers already exist underneath. What is new here is the rules table: item, category, customer group or whole-bill rules with dates, priority and stacking, which is ERPNext's Pricing Rule without its Promotional Scheme generator.

Nothing on this artboard is built yet. Tell me what is missing before I start.

Three type pairings, since you asked to see alternatives.

All three use faces Windows already ships, because the counter must work offline and a downloaded font would not load. Figures stay monospaced in each — a column of amounts that does not line up costs more than any font gains.

Say which and I will switch the app over.
